digest.component_or_area: test suite invariants and timeout validation
propositions: Two test cases assert on source-code string presence (shellcheck comment, asyncio.run call) rather than runtime behavior, making them brittle to refactoring.
The shellcheck-prior-art test is fully subsumed by an existing behavioral linting test sibling and should be deleted or downgraded to a comment-presence guard.
The no-total-timeout test should drop exact-string assertions on asyncio.run() and signal.alarm, since timeout liveness is already validated by behavioral timeout probes.
Both guards must be explicitly documented as structural/supplemental if retained and excluded from behavioral coverage inventory.
